summary: DeepSeek announced general availability of DeepSeek-V4-Pro with agent and reasoning-effort feature updates, native OpenAI Responses API support, and a new peak/off-peak API pricing structure taking effect August 16, 2026.

practices.reason: The release claims agent and reasoning-effort improvements but gives no benchmark or quantified result to act on.
practices.quote: 🔷 Major Agent upgrades with strong production gains! 🔷 Flexible reasoning effort for V4-Pro & V4-Flash: low for simple tasks, high for daily Agent workflows, max for complex tasks.

practices.reason: Adding native OpenAI Responses API support with one-click Codex setup is a concrete interface change teams would need to integrate or update against.
practices.quote: 🔷 Native OpenAI Responses API support, optimized for Codex with one-click setup.

practices.reason: The new peak/off-peak pricing tiers with a stated effective date require engineering teams to schedule or shift workloads to capture the discount.
practices.quote: With the V4 lineup release, we’re updating our API pricing and introducing peak and off-peak rates. Off-peak rates are 50% lower than peak, enabling more flexible workload scheduling.
